unsupported: Bayne Custom Woodworking operates from a 20-by-25-foot outbuilding in Mt. Juliet, Tennessee, just east of Nashville.
The clientele is almost entirely residential, serving homeowners across Middle Tennessee who want made-to-measure furniture, restoration of family heirlooms, or one-of-a-kind live-edge pieces.
Bayne frames the work as a gift he stewards rather than a commercial venture, emphasizing detailed upfront design, locally sourced material, and the uniqueness of each build.
